player_0.content: New plan: I incorrectly prioritized Marcus's competitive spirit ("Excited") and his acceptance of the challenge ("Challenged") while underestimating the sting of Reggie's personal attack regarding his past failures ("Humiliated"). The dialogue explicitly links Marcus's "dirty" play to a history of being mocked for his corporate style and forgotten appearances. Next time, I will re-evaluate the emotional weight of the insult "Low blow, sis" and the specific reference to his "powerpoint presentation" and "forgetting to show up." I will assign a significantly higher score to "Humiliated" (reflecting the vulnerability exposed) and a lower score to "Excited," recognizing that his motivation is likely defensive pride rather than genuine enthusiasm for the competition.
